description: The Global Geothermal Power Tracker from Global Energy Monitor (GEM), a non-profit research organisation, is a worldwide data set of geothermal power facilities. On 26 September 2026 the page counted 835 units in 50 countries and areas, with 16.6 GW operating and 14.3 GW prospective capacity. Records give capacity, operational status, installation and technology type, location and ownership, and summary tables show capacity by country, region and year and the leading owners. The latest release was March 2026. Coverage is global. Access is through a free online tracker map, dashboards and summary tables, and the full data set is a spreadsheet downloadable through a short download form on GEM's site, under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: status and dates of prospective units change between releases. Simulation uses are generation fleet inputs, volcanic and earthquake exposure of plants in active regions and renewable planning. Related records: data-gem-global-integrated-power-tracker combines GEM's power trackers and data-gem-global-energy-ownership-tracker maps owners.
